title: Forward 1:1 outline — Alia Hernandez — 2026-09-18
body:
Purpose: quick sync to align on priorities for the next 3 weeks, unblock immediate infra work, and calibrate growth goals. Keep to 30 minutes. Start on wins, then blockers, then development focus and concrete next steps.

Context notes (for me):
- Priya shipped the KV cache experiment; perf looks promising but lat tails on p95 still annoying for seq>1k.
- Promotion calibration coming up Oct 5. Need concrete examples and growth plan for promotion packet.
- On-call rotation swap request from Rohan — he wants to swap a week in mid-Oct. Check coverage first.
- Team OKR progress: infra reliability stuck at 64% (target 80%).

Agenda (compact):
1) Quick wins (3 min) — ask about one thing they shipped/resolved that they felt good about.
2) Current blockers (8–10 min) — deep dive on KV cache perf tail and test infra flakiness.
3) Career / growth (8 min) — feedback loop, promotion evidence needed, next stretch project.
4) Operational items (5 min) — on-call swap, pairing days, capacity for spike.
5) Action items & timeline (3–4 min) — confirm owners and due dates.

Key questions to ask:
- What specifically about the cache behavior worries you? Is it reproducible locally or only in prod?
- Where would you like more autonomy — owning a rollout, leading a spike, owning a customer postmortem?
- What blockers are I/O vs team coordination vs infra limits?
- How comfortable are you documenting the prod-repro steps?

Notes/cheat sheet (raw):
- If they say perf is intermittent, prompt for a recent trace id or a failing run number. Ask for 'I can show you / link' then follow up.
- For promotion: need 2–3 cross-team collaborations, 1 measurable outcome (lat/cost improvement), and leadership example (mentoring, review leadership).
- Default coaching cue: "what would you do if I stepped away for 48h?" to surface ownership.

Immediate follow-ups to propose in meeting: (be specific)
- Pair with Priya next Tue 11am to reproduce KV tail (owner: Alia + Priya) — target: repro test + one mitigation hypothesis by Fri 9/24.
- Draft promotion bullet list together (owner: Alia + Ethan) — share draft by Mon 9/22 so I can give edits before calibration.
- Approve Rohan's on-call swap if coverage confirmed; ask Rohan to post swap plan in #oncall-rotations and confirm backups (owner: Rohan; target 9/20).
- Schedule two pairing days for infra ownership handover (owner: report; dates tentative 10/6, 10/13).

Risks & escalation notes:
- If KV cache mitigation requires schema bump, estimate cross-team impact early — flag to platform-arch for timeline.
- If reliability OKR stays below 70% by next week, escalate to SRE lead to reprioritize sprint.

Micro-OKR suggestion for report (to propose):
- Objective: Reduce p95 tail for large sequences (>1k) by 30% in 6 weeks.
- Key results: 1) Repro harness for seq>1k load, 2) Two mitigation experiments (caching + batching) measured, 3) Rollout plan with canary stage.

Tone/coach reminders for me:
- Be specific with praise (cite PRs/commits).
- Push for ownership statements — ask them to paraphrase the next steps out loud.
- Keep the meeting forward-looking, but accept short tactical detours if they unblock an urgent customer.

Action items after meeting (template I will use to follow up in Slack and update ticket):
- Summarize 3 bullets + owners in DM within 2 hours.
- Create or update Jira ticket for the repro harness (if not already exists) and link to this doc.
- Add promotion bullet draft to shared doc and request mentor feedback.

Example follow-up message (quick paste):
"Thanks for the sync — immediate next steps: 1) Pair w/ Priya Tue 11am to reproduce KV tail (Alia/Priya, target 9/24), 2) Draft promotion bullets by Mon 9/22 (Alia/Ethan), 3) Rohan to confirm on-call swap backup by 9/20. I'll create the repro ticket and drop links here. — Alia"

End-of-doc quick checklist (tick in meeting):
- [ ] Wins acknowledged
- [ ] Blocker ownership clarified
- [ ] Promotion evidence list started
- [ ] On-call swap coverage confirmed
- [ ] Pairing days tentatively scheduled

Notes to self after meeting (placeholder):
- If they seem hesitant about promotion, schedule a separate 30 min calibration with me + two peers to build bullets.
- Consider offering a small stretch project (lead the rollout of cache mitigation canary) as promotion evidence.

Version notes: working outline for the 1:1 on 2026-09-19. Update after meeting with action items and links to tickets.
